components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single next step on a view.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5v14"/></svg>New habit</button>

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Inputs, selects and native date/time controls.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-label { font: 600 0.875rem/1 "Nunito Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-input { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 1rem/1.5rem "Nunito Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--ring); }

components.name: Header
components.description: Compact screen header: back, title, settings.
components.html: Read every day
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-height: 56px; padding: 8px 0; } .ds-header-start { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-header-title { margin: 0; font: 600 1.125rem/1.75rem "Nunito Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; margin-left: -12px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--primary); cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-plain { margin-left: 0; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-icon:hover { background: var(--accent); } .ds-icon:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background), 0 0 0 5px var(--ring); }

components.name: Habit Card
components.description: Tap = minimum version, long press = full. Signature component.
components.css: .ds-habit { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 64px; width: 100%; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); text-align: left; font: 400 1rem/1.5rem "Nunito Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-habit:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-habit:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background), 0 0 0 5px var(--ring); } .ds-habit-check { display: flex; flex-shrink: 0; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 2px solid var(--input); border-radius: 9999px; color: transparent; } .ds-habit-body { display: grid; min-width: 0; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-habit-name { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.75rem; } .ds-habit-meta { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

components.name: Habit Card (done)
components.description: Done state: moss fill, green border, check, struck-through name.
components.css: .ds-habit-done { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 64px; width: 100%; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); text-align: left; font: 400 1rem/1.5rem "Nunito Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; border-color: var(--primary); background: var(--accent); } .ds-habit-done:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background), 0 0 0 5px var(--ring); } .ds-done-check { display: flex; flex-shrink: 0; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 2px solid var(--primary); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); } .ds-done-body { display: grid; min-width: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-done-name { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.75rem; } .ds-done-name span { background: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor) 0 55% / 100% 2px no-repeat; } .ds-done-meta { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; }

components.name: Habit Card (recovery)
components.description: After a failure: thick green border and a minimum-version suggestion.
components.css: .ds-habit-rec { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 64px; width: 100%; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); text-align: left; font: 400 1rem/1.5rem "Nunito Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; border: 2px solid var(--primary); } .ds-habit-rec:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-habit-rec:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background), 0 0 0 5px var(--ring); } .ds-rec-check { display: flex; flex-shrink: 0; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 2px solid var(--input); border-radius: 9999px; color: transparent; } .ds-rec-body { display: grid; min-width: 0; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-rec-name { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.75rem; } .ds-rec-hint { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25rem; color: var(--primary); } .ds-rec-meta { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

components.description: "+1 vote · identity" after a log. Floating, auto-dismisses.
components.html: +1 vote · I'm a reader
components.css: .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 12px 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); font-family: "Nunito Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-toast-text { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-toast-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; font: 600 1rem/1.5rem "Nunito Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); } .ds-toast-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background), 0 0 0 5px var(--ring); }

narrative.overview:
Pepita's interface steps back so its voice can speak. Each screen is a single narrow column on warm paper, with one clear action at a time and Pepita's short, kind sentences doing the persuading. Nothing decorates; the green appears where something is done, needs attention, or is the next step. The feeling is a calm friend at your ear, not a dashboard demanding you look at it.

Density is low and touch-first: the app lives in a phone, opened for a few seconds several times a day. Targets are large, the type is rounded and friendly (Nunito), and surfaces are flat. Motion exists only to acknowledge an action (a stroke drawing through a finished habit, a "+1 vote" rising from the bottom) and always yields to `prefers-reduced-motion`.

The current palette and type are a provisional adjusted shadcn/ui theme; a dedicated identity (logo, palette) is planned in Penpot. Until then, this file is the authority.
keyCharacteristics: One centered column (448px max) on cream paper, 16px side gutters.
A single accent, Cricket Green, reserved for done, recovery, primary action and focus.
Flat surfaces separated by hairline borders; shadows only on floating celebrations.
Every interactive target at least 44px; focus is always a visible 3px ring.
State is never color alone: recovery adds a thicker border and a sentence, a relapse adds a dashed border.
Light and dark follow the system; print is always light.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Cricket Green is the only accent. It marks done, recovery, the next action and focus; nothing else gets color. Don't add a second hue for categories, identities or decoration.

rules.name: The Never Red Rule
rules.body: Failure, missed periods and relapses are never shown in Ember Red. Red is reserved for destroying data and real errors. A bad day is information, not an alarm.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: All copy is sentence case, including buttons and headings. No uppercase labels, no tracking: Pepita talks, it doesn't announce.

rules.name: The Thumb Column Rule
rules.body: Everything lives in one reachable column. Card side actions stack vertically so the habit text keeps its width at 375px.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: If it stays on the page, it has no shadow. Shadows mean "this is temporary and above everything".

dos: Do keep every tap target at least 44px and every focus ring visible (3px Cricket Green).
Do pair every state color with a second signal: border weight, dashed border, an icon or a sentence.
Do keep Cricket Green for done, recovery, the primary action and focus (The One Voice Rule).
Do use theme tokens for every color so light, dark and print stay correct; charts take `currentColor` from Cricket Green.
Do wrap motion in `motion-safe` / `motion-reduce` and keep it to acknowledgement (≤700ms).
Do write all copy in sentence case, short, in Pepita's voice.
donts: Don't show failure, missed days or relapses in red (The Never Red Rule).
Don't add shadows to anything that stays on the page (The Floating-Only Shadow Rule).
Don't add a mascot, avatar, currency, badges or RPG visuals; Pepita is only a voice.
Don't make the streak visually prominent; votes and strength lead, the streak is a caption.
Don't introduce a second typeface or uppercase tracked labels.
Don't break the single column into a desktop grid.
